data.name: Lennie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Leon, meaning 'lion'. The name Lennie is a diminutive form and is often given to boys. In Christian tradition, the lion is a symbol of courage, strength, and Christ.

It is a reminder of the courage and resilience that comes from having faith and trust in God during challenging times. The name Lennie is a powerful reminder of the strength and power of the Christian faith.
